$comment: Assets the workspace saves: links, notes and files (declared in collection.yaml, chapter 13). Every document must match this JSON Schema (draft 2020-12); backd adds id and _meta itself.

title.description: What the asset is called. Required.

kind.description: A URL worth keeping, a written note, or a file (chapter 13).

tags.description: Free-form labels; where={"tags":"docs"} finds documents whose array contains the value.

published_at.description: null while a draft. Stored as a BSON date so filters, ranges and sorting compare instants.

downloads.description: How many times the download function opened a file of this asset (chapter 15). Only that function writes it: the rules refuse clients.
